meta_title: Crypto Payments for Freelancers & Creators | Dynopay
meta_description: Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and 10+ cryptocurrencies. No chargebacks, no platform holds. 1.5% flat fee. Start accepting crypto payments in 10 minutes.
h1: Accept crypto payments for freelancers & creators without chargebacks
subheading: Get paid in Bitcoin, stablecoins, and 10+ cryptocurrencies directly to your wallet. No middleman holds your funds, no disputed payments.
intro_paragraph: Freelancers and creators lose income to chargebacks, refund abuse, and payment holds on traditional platforms. Dynopay is a non-custodial gateway that sends crypto payments directly to your wallet—you control your funds from the moment a client pays. Support Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on three chains, Solana, XRP, and stablecoins. Live in under 10 minutes with a 1.5% flat fee and no monthly costs.

features.title: Your wallet, your custody always
features.description: Payments arrive directly in your own Bitcoin, Ethereum, or stablecoin wallet. Dynopay never holds your funds, so you have full control and instant access to every payment you receive.

features.title: No chargebacks, ever
features.description: Cryptocurrency transactions are final. Clients can't dispute payments 60 days later, so you keep what you earn from digital products, consulting, memberships, and commissions without refund abuse.

features.title: Flat 1.5% fee, no surprises
features.description: Pay 1.5% per transaction plus a small fixed component based on order size. No monthly fees, no setup costs, no hidden charges for withdrawals or currency conversion.

how_it_works: Sign up with your email, verify, and create your company profile in Dynopay's dashboard.
Add one payout wallet address for Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, or any supported cryptocurrency.
Generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget on your site and start accepting payments.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies can I accept as a freelancer?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports Bitcoin, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Dogecoin, Ethereum, USDT on Ethereum/Polygon/Tron, USDC and RLUSD on Ethereum, MATIC, Solana, TRX, XRP, and RLUSD on XRP Ledger. Clients pay in any supported asset, and you receive funds in your chosen wallet.

faqs.question: Do I need a business bank account to accept crypto payments?
faqs.answer: No. Dynopay sends payments directly to your personal or business crypto wallet. You control the private keys, and funds never pass through a custodial account. No bank account required to receive cryptocurrency.

faqs.question: Can international clients pay me without currency conversion fees?
faqs.answer: Yes. Clients anywhere in the world can pay in cryptocurrency without forex markups or cross-border fees. You receive the crypto directly, and Dynopay charges a flat 1.5% platform fee regardless of sender location.

faqs.question: What happens if a client tries to dispute a crypto payment?
faqs.answer: Cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible by design. Once a client sends payment and it confirms on the blockchain, they cannot initiate a chargeback. You keep the full amount minus the 1.5% Dynopay fee.

faqs.question: How long does it take to start accepting crypto as a freelancer?
faqs.answer: Under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, create a company profile, add one wallet address for payouts, and generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget on your portfolio or invoice.

cta_headline: Start accepting crypto payments in 10 minutes
cta_body: No monthly fees, no chargebacks, no platform holds your funds. Sign up and add your wallet to go live today.
